models.limits: Independent bounded initial-state/result oracle for simulator-specific ordered receipt consumption, per-entry failures and transaction publication. A repeated current handle under distinct IDs succeeds only at its first entry; all-invalid semantic results can commit legitimate scoped expiry cleanup. Transaction queue rereads use the current incarnation, with abstract final drift checks; no cached HTTP incarnation precondition is invented. Assumes immutable policy, collision-free ordinary receipt issuance, a frozen retention cutoff, and atomic transaction commit/rollback. Corrupt duplicate persisted handles and trigger-like ignored writes/reinsertions are explicit faults. No Go/SQL refinement, wire parser/URL/ARN/string/Unicode proof, policy evaluator proof, real wall-clock, crash/restart/disk durability, concurrent request, network, FIFO, other batch API, or full AWS behavior/parity claim. Native tests remain independent evidence.
